name: Jake the Misfit
bio: Jake Martin better known as Jake the Misfit is a hip-hop artist, videographer and member of MSON (Making Something Outta Nothing) from Darwin, Northern Territory. Of Filipino and Czech decent, he fell in love with the hip-hop culture at a young age. He started writing music at the age of thirteen and was inspired by many artists from all genres. Hoping one day his music will reach far and wide, Jake is a pivotal member of the MSON hip-hop movement as a lyricist and videographer.

credits.title: Mad Sesh
credits.overview: Socially awkward Ben pays a visit to a seasoned stoner hoping to become one of the cool kids, but when his first smoking session spirals into a paranoid nightmare, he must decide whether fitting in is worth losing himself.
